about: Menu research for Roses Kebab Land (Kian via the PM, 2026-10-12): every item shown on the page that day. Descriptions where the field was empty (newEn, newFa; null = the venue's own text stays), and the allergen and dietary drafts with their basis (the assumed key ingredients and a source for the dish type, from simple web research). Drafts only: allergens and dietary words are never on the public page until an owner or admin confirms them; the descriptions are shown and marked as drafts in the admin. Applied by tools/import/research-apply.mjs (also in npm run setup); reviewed in reports/research-review-kebab-land.csv. Rules: research-report.md beside this file.

items.name: Borsao (Spain)
items.newEn: Spanish wine from Bodegas Borsao in Campo de Borja, Aragón, home of old-vine Garnacha; ask your server which bottle.
items.newFa: شراب اسپانیایی از بودگاس بورسائو در کامپو د بورخا، آراگون، سرزمین تاکستان‌های کهن گارناچا؛ نوعش را از گارسون بپرسید.
items.note: Which Borsao wine to confirm (mostly Garnacha reds; also rosé and white).

items.name: Bordeaux (France)
items.newEn: A French red from Bordeaux, usually a blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon: dry, structured and made for the grill.
items.newFa: شراب قرمز فرانسوی از بوردو، معمولاً ترکیبی از مرلو و کابرنه سوینیون؛ خشک و خوش‌ساختار، برای سفره‌ی کباب.
items.note: Assumed red (most Bordeaux is): venue to confirm the château and blend.

items.name: Pinot Noir (France)
items.newEn: French Pinot Noir, the red grape of Burgundy: light to medium-bodied, silky and fragrant, with gentle tannins.
items.newFa: پینو نوآر فرانسوی، انگور قرمز بورگونی؛ سبک تا متوسط، لطیف و خوش‌عطر با تانن ملایم.
items.note: Producer and region not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Raki
items.newEn: Turkish anise spirit distilled from grapes; with cold water it turns cloudy white. A classic beside grilled kebabs.
items.newFa: عرق انیسون ترکیه‌ای از تقطیر انگور؛ با آب سرد سفید و کدر می‌شود. همراه کلاسیک کباب.
items.note: Brand and the serving size for 19.99 not named: venue to confirm; distilled grape spirit, no sulphites expected.

items.name: Aragh Sagi
items.newEn: Iran's traditional spirit, distilled from fermented raisins: clear, strong and aromatic, for sipping slowly beside your kebab.
items.newFa: عرق کشمش به رسم قدیم ایرانی؛ زلال، تند و خوش‌عطر، برای جرعه‌جرعه نوشیدن کنار کباب.
items.note: Raisins are often sulphited when dried; drafted because the description names raisins (a distilled spirit may carry little or none): Kian to keep or remove. Brand not named; distilled from raisins, sulphites not expected after distillation: bottle label to confirm.

items.name: Pinot Grigio
items.newEn: A light, crisp and dry white in the Italian style, with refreshing acidity and a clean finish.
items.newFa: شراب سفید سبک و خشک به شیوه‌ی ایتالیایی؛ ترش‌مزه، تازه و خوش‌نوش.
items.note: Producer not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Sauvignon Blanc
items.newEn: A crisp, dry, zesty white with lively acidity and grassy to tropical notes; refreshing between bites of kebab.
items.newFa: شراب سفید خشک و ترش‌مزه با عطری علفی و استوایی؛ میان لقمه‌های کباب، خنک و دلچسب.
items.note: Producer and origin not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Chardonnay
items.newEn: A medium-bodied white with a round, soft texture: fresh, fruity and easy alongside grilled kebabs.
items.newFa: شراب سفید با بدنه‌ی متوسط و بافتی نرم و لطیف؛ تازه، میوه‌ای و خوش‌نوش کنار کباب.
items.note: Producer not named; oaked or unoaked to confirm.

items.name: Shiraz
items.newEn: A full-bodied, jammy red with soft tannins and a spicy finish; a natural match for charcoal-grilled kebabs.
items.newFa: شراب قرمز پرقوام و مربایی با تانن نرم و ته‌مزه‌ای گرم و تند؛ کنار کباب زغالی خوب می‌نشیند.
items.note: Producer and origin not named (style varies with climate): venue to confirm.

items.name: Cab Sauv
items.newEn: A full-bodied red with firm tannins, fresh acidity and dark-fruited depth; stands up well to charcoal-grilled kebabs.
items.newFa: شراب قرمز پرقوام با تانن محکم، ترشی دلپذیر و عمقی میوه‌ای؛ پابه‌پای کباب زغالی.
items.note: Producer and origin not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Merlot
items.newEn: A soft, round and fruity red with velvety tannins; easy-drinking with any kebab from the grill.
items.newFa: شراب قرمز نرم و میوه‌ای با تانن‌های مخملی؛ خوش‌نوش کنار هر کبابی.
items.note: Producer and origin not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Rose
items.newEn: Pink wine from red grapes, served chilled: fresh, fruity and light, easy alongside anything from the grill.
items.newFa: شراب صورتی از انگور قرمز که خنک سرو می‌شود؛ تازه، سبک و میوه‌ای، کنار هر چیزی از روی منقل.
items.note: Producer, grapes and sweetness not named: venue to confirm.

items.name: Prosecco
items.newEn: Italian sparkling wine from the Glera grape of Veneto and Friuli: light, fresh and bubbly, a bright start to the meal.
items.newFa: شراب گازدار ایتالیایی از انگور گلرا، از ونتو و فریولی؛ سبک، تازه و پرحباب، شروعی دلپذیر برای سفره.
items.note: Producer not named.
